name: Paul Pfitzner
original_name: パウル・プフィッツナー
source:
One of the exchange students from Harshreich. He doesn't stand out much, so people have a hard time remembering his name. His hobby is cooking, but he feels guilty about it. He is also good at helping people with studying.

Likes: Cooking, walks, sunshine.
Dislikes: Bugs, noisy places.

[Taken from [url=http://kaiju09.com/knights_college/english/]official character profile[/url].]

[spoiler]Paul passed away around 10 years prior to the story, caused by illness from his E.P. ability manifesting. His ability is to manipulate his spectral from. He isn't able to leave the island on which Knights College is on.[/spoiler]
